author: claude-code
head: 3e5cad37118dfed6836eb3b1e52541198b43b7d7
body: Orchestrator review of PR #336 (dotfiles-T128-orchestrator-tools-a04, the INV-6 successor of a03 after plan 016 option G′; T718 first slice) at its final head: scripts/orchestrator/dispatch.sh, three-repeat.sh, bus-read.sh, the S1 line of scripts/regime-counters.sh and the two test modules, outside .orchestration/. Each script does what items 1 and 3 of a04 say and nothing else: dispatch.sh reads exactly one line, requires exactly one task_id and, for a TASK, task_file and task_sha256, recomputes every *_sha256 from the file its sibling token names, refuses an unwritable or missing record and a malformed record block before the send, and records the sent line with its read marker under the record's dispatch key; three-repeat.sh validates the class slug, searches classes: and the record bodies from its own checkout, and states or raises the memory count's cap; bus-read.sh applies the stop gate's closing rule (peer-bound; any non-revise ACCEPTANCE closes), skips and counts rows outside its grammar, refuses a capped read and prints the minutes since each open task's latest event; the counters' S1 line reads the class slug from the record's ledger with jq. The six tests of the reset exist and pass in CI; the Bot's threads on the final head and the local review's findings are each fixed in the head or owned by dotfiles-T128-orchestrator-tools-a02 on main; INV-2 caps hold. Approved for the gate at the audited head.
